summary: CSS-only regression pass for KrunchMate layout fixes at three viewport widths (1280 proxy 100%, 1024 proxy 125%, 1600 proxy 90%). Backend 4/4 pytest passing. Frontend: no horizontal scrollbar on any of 5 pages (Home/Shop/About/FAQ/Contact) at any of the 3 widths (15/15 combos scrollWidth == clientWidth). Hero headline does not overflow left column at 1024; hero and pouch bounding rects do not intersect; nav does not collide. Flavour switch (PB <-> S&V) causes only a 9px height delta (visually stable). Cart drawer at 1024x700 fits within viewport with checkout button fully visible. Three-pillars/reviews/bundle sections render as 3-column grids at 1600 with no overflow. Shop pack discount regression is now FIXED — 3x Salt & Vinegar cart subtotal reads £10.68 exactly as required.
critical_code_review_comments: CSS fixes cleanly target the four root causes described. overflow-wrap, min-width:0 on flex/grid children, capped .pouch-stage, and reduced clamp() maxes prevent all observed overflow at 1024/1280/1600.
One minor testing note: initial Home page networkidle timed out due to hero video/font loading — using domcontentloaded works fine. Not a bug, just a slow initial paint.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Layout at 1280/1024/1600 all clean. Backend has two endpoints; pytest at /app/backend/tests/test_krunchmate_api.py is stable. Shop discount (3x SV -> £10.68) was previously broken in iteration 1 and is now confirmed working — no regression. Cart drawer overlays the whole viewport when open, so any test needing footer interaction should close the drawer first (this is only a test flow consideration, not a bug).
